verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state that Identity can match government-issued photo IDs with selfies, which covers the face-match core of the story. The pack says nothing about liveness detection or defenses against spoofing; the only fraud reference is a generic note that 'programmatic systems work to detect fraudulent verifications.' Missing for 10: documented liveness detection, documented defenses against printed photos, screens and replayed video, details of match methodology or accuracy, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of selfie-check robustness.
